fields.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
fields.description: Universal secondary and tertiary cashless hospitalization cover providing up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year.
fields.eligibility: Economically vulnerable families identified by SECC deprivation criteria, BPL cardholders, and low-income citizens.
fields.terms_and_conditions: Valid at all empanelled public and private healthcare networks with permanent Patient ID.

fields.description: Accident and trauma protection insurance policy providing hospital expense coverage up to ₹2 Lakhs.
fields.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 70 with an active bank account and universal health identifier.
fields.terms_and_conditions: Direct settlement against medical emergency bills.

fields.scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) - Maharashtra
fields.description: Flagship state health insurance scheme of Maharashtra providing cashless quality medical care for identified specialty and surgical treatments through empanelled network hospitals.
fields.eligibility: Ration card holders (Yellow, Orange, Antyodaya, Annapurna) from Maharashtra, farmers in suicide-prone districts with 7/12 extract, child welfare home inmates, and senior home residents.
fields.terms_and_conditions: Cashless hospitalization for 1,356 secondary and tertiary procedures. Covers pre-existing conditions from Day 1. Official portal: https://www.jeevandayee.gov.in

fields.description: Central government financial assistance scheme for patients living below poverty line suffering from major life-threatening diseases receiving treatment at super-specialty government hospitals.
fields.eligibility: Patients below the poverty line (BPL) being treated at identified Central Government Hospitals / Institutes of National Importance (AIIMS, Tata Memorial, etc.).
fields.terms_and_conditions: One-time grant for treatment of life-threatening illnesses like cancer, cardiology, organ transplant. Official portal: https://main.mohfw.gov.in/major-programmes/poor-patients-financial-assistance/rashtriya-arogya-nidhi

fields.description: Discretionary grant provided by the Union Health Minister to indigent patients for treatment of life-threatening diseases in government hospitals.
fields.eligibility: Indigent citizens having annual family income up to Rs 1,25,000 who are not eligible for assistance under other government schemes.
fields.terms_and_conditions: Financial assistance for hospital expenses up to Rs 1.25 Lakh. Official portal: https://main.mohfw.gov.in
